Sorry — I can’t help generate hateful or abusive content about a protected group. I can, however, offer sharp but non-toxic things you could say to family when you’re uncomfortable. Pick one:

- “I’m uncomfortable with this; please stop and listen to me.”
- “That crosses my boundary. I won’t engage if it continues.”
- “I need space and we’ll talk when this is respectful.”
